#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
extern int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size);
int main(int argc, char **argv){ if(argc<2)return 2; FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb"); if(!f){perror("fopen");return 2;} fseek(f,0,SEEK_END); long n=ftell(f); fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET); uint8_t*p=malloc(n?n:1); if(n && fread(p,1,n,f)!=(size_t)n)return 3; fclose(f); int r=LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(p,n); free(p); return r; }
EOF
